evaluation_method: The offline evaluator runs both formulations against the same corpus and compares AI recall, false-filter rate, uncertain rate, excerpt size, and latency. Keep the formulation that meets the false-filter budget while preserving recall.

last_offline_measurement.selection: semantic-v2 remains selected because it states the local-versus-semantic boundary explicitly; live evaluation should be rerun before changing the default.
